checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate finished assets delivered: 4:5 poster, 9:16 story, 9:16 reel
must.why: Three assets exist, but the poster is 9:16, not 4:5. The user never picked a shape, and the agent defaulted to 9:16.

must.item: All three use warm lantern imagery and coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design
must.why: All three show glowing lanterns on a deep blue night. The poster and story use gold type. The reel has a blue sky and warm gold lights.

must.item: Each asset includes exact event name, date, time, venue, free-entry wording
must.why: The poster misspells the title as 'Lanterm'. The story has a garbled duplicate title. The reel's end card was not visible in the sampled frames.

must.item: Reel runs 10 seconds with visible motion
must.why: The reel moves (the camera glides and the lanterns change position), but the total is 15 s, not 10. Only the 10 s clip frames were seen.

must.item: Text legible and unclipped in both images; reel holds details long enough
must.why: The poster title has a typo. The story has a smeared, duplicated title. The reel frames from 1 s to 9.5 s carry no text. The end card was not verified.

exact_text.read_as: Poster: 'Lanterm Night Market'. Story: 'Lantern Night Market' in large gold, plus a garbled duplicate 'Lantern Night / Market' lower down.
Riverside Yard (slightly smeared on the story)

faults.what: Story has a duplicated, smeared title ('Lantern Night Market') with warped letters, a clear AI text artefact.
The reel is 15 s with a code-drawn end card, not the requested 10 s. The sampled frames from 1 s to 9.5 s have no text, so event details appear only in the end card, which was not verified.
The poster is 9:16 instead of the 4:5 format.
The story shows all five lines, but the agent's message described it as having only a 'Free Entry' label.
The poster has people in the crowd with slightly AI-looking detail. The reel has a strange brown blob in the water in frame 1.

summary: The lantern imagery and blue-and-gold look are attractive, but the poster title is misspelled ('Lanterm'), the story has a garbled duplicate title, and the reel is 15 s with its text-bearing end card not verified.
